newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MERRILL LYNCH OUT OF TELECOM TENDER BID.
newsitem.headline: MERRILL LYNCH OUT OF TELECOM TENDER BID.

text.p: Lithuania's Telecom tender commission said on Thursday that Merrill Lynch will be excluded from participating in the tender to act as lead advisor for the privatisation of Lithuanian Telecom because its bid was late.

"Merrill Lynch will not be permitted to participate in the tender since it submitted its offer this morning, after the deadline expired," the head of the Telecom tender commission, Vytenis Junevichius, told Reuters.
The deadline to submit the offer expired on Wednesday at 1800 (1500 GMT).

The ministry said earlier that offers were received from Creditanstalt Invesment Bank, Union Bank of Switzerland, Banque Paribas, Flemings, Deutche Morgan Grenfell, N.M. Rothschild & Sons Ltd and Daiwa Institute of Research.
The tender commission began consideration of the offers on Thursday and the results of are expected in around a week.
